source.title: WQAC Leader Announcement (July 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Roxana Johnson has been appointed as the new Leader of the WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC). Roxana was already working as a Senior Member of the WQAC.

<!-- break -->
Roxana was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of July 13, 2026.

We would like to thank Dan Smith, who had taken on an interim leadership role for the team while a new Leader was being appointed, and wish Roxana the best of luck in her new role. Dan will remain as a Senior Member of the WQAC for a short while. 

Roxana was the only applicant for the role, and her successful candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MKm-6jg6nvIStwzJUn7PV-9JDTmddILR?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会负责人任命公告（2026 年 7 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Roxana Johnson 已被任命为 WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）的新任负责人。Roxana 此前已是 WQAC 的高级成员。

WCA 董事会依据《WCA 委员会与团队[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)》第 5 节，选出 Roxana，并通过投票批准了这一任命。任命自 2026 年 7 月 13 日生效。

在遴选新负责人期间，Dan Smith 曾临时领导该团队，我们谨向他表示感谢，并祝 Roxana 在新的岗位上一切顺利。Dan 将暂时继续担任 WQAC 高级成员。

Roxana 是这一岗位的唯一申请人，其申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MKm-6jg6nvIStwzJUn7PV-9JDTmddILR?usp=sharing)查看。
